title: Legendary vs Mythical Pokémon
script: This is a Legendary Pokémon. This is a Mythical Pokémon. So what's the difference? Most people think they're the same rare, powerful Pokémon. They're not. Legendary Pokémon are typically caught in-game, often central to the main story. Mythical Pokémon are even rarer, usually distributed through real-world events or special promotions, often having unique lore. That's why you *can catch Rayquaza in Emerald*, while you *needed an event for Mew*. Follow for more.
